postoutcome_audit: All primary MSE and stable stratum MSE reproduced from per-block plot-equal loss sums; 2000 fixed-seed jointly resampled spatial blocks within each region. Exploratory conditional intervals, not independent confirmatory inference.

summary.limitations: Size-class composition, not reproductive maturity or climate causation; count losses limited to explicit links; block bootstrap conditional on fitted predictors and regional species set.
